description:
Here at OCI we’re building the world’s largest AI clusters and we’re the fastest at bringing them to the market. The AI Infrastructure organization at OCI is leading this effort by creating a GPU focused cloud with the latest hardware providing the best performance, efficiency, reliability, and scalability. This is your chance to be part of the AI revolution by creating systems that allow customers to scale from tens to thousands of GPUs without compromising performance. You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and make a significant impact on our organization's success.

We are looking for a highly skilled distributed systems engineer to scale and optimize AI infrastructure components like GPU control plane and GPU data plane that provide computing resources to customer AI workloads. You will provide technical leadership to the team and bring clarity to ambiguous problems and come up with innovative solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance our AI infrastructure to deliver exceptional customer experience and peak performance.

Responsibilities
- Design and develop solutions to scale and optimize AI compute infrastructure components like GPU control plane and GPU data plane with the goal to optimize customer experience and customer workload performance on our AI infrastructure.

- Develop “best-in-class” AI compute infrastructure for our customers by ensuring that the services and the components are well-defined and modularized, secure, reliable, diagnosable, actively monitored, compliant and reusable.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including development, operations, and product management, to understand their requirements and design innovative orchestration solutions.

- Mentor junior developers and drive modern software engineering practices like leveraging data/telemetry to make decisions, well-defined interfaces across components, design reviews, coding standards, code reviews, and comprehensive coverage from unit test, integration test and active production monitoring.

- Develop benchmark metrics and automation to drive and track performance and reliability across customer workload and lower infrastructure stack. ­

Qualifications & Skills 
- BS (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

- 5+ years of experience in software development with programming languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, Go, Rust. 

- 3 years of experience designing and developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems, and services.

- 1 year of experience providing technical leadership and clarity to cross-functional teams and projects while collaborating across stake holders.

- Systematic problem-solving approach, strong communication skills, a sense of ownership, and drive.

- Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in managing cloud infrastructure with hundreds of thousands of servers.

- Experience in containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

- Experience in scheduling high-performance workloads on Kubernetes or Slurm.

Career Level - IC3

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (React + Python)
description:
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. 
With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes. 

Our Mumbai office was launched in 2024, marking an exciting new chapter for us. We’re building the team with people who are eager to shape something from the ground up — combining the agility and entrepreneurial energy of a startup with the backing and reach of a global brand.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Full Stack Engineer (React + Python) for our Mumbai location. This role involves developing scalable, high-performing web applications for our AI-powered SaaS solutions. You will work across frontend and backend systems, building intuitive user interfaces using React and robust backend services using Python, while collaborating closely with product, design, DevOps, and engineering teams. 
Key Responsibilities:
Frontend Development: Develop and optimize responsive, user-friendly interfaces using ReactJS, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs. 
Backend Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask. 
API Development & Integration: Build, maintain, and optimize RESTful APIs; integrate frontend applications with backend services, databases, and third-party platforms. 
Database Management: Work with SQL and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL and MongoDB, ensuring data integrity, performance, and scalability. 
Performance Optimization: Improve frontend rendering, application responsiveness, backend performance, and API reliability. 
Code Integrity: Maintain and improve code quality through unit testing, integration testing, automation, documentation, and code reviews. 
Containerization & Cloud Deployment: Use Docker and Kubernetes to deploy and manage containerized applications. Work with GCP, AWS, or Azure for cloud deployment and application management. 
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Utilize Terraform and Helm to manage cloud infrastructure and ensure scalable, efficient deployment environments. 
CI/CD Management: Contribute to continuous integration and deployment processes, including test automation, build artifact creation, and application releases.

3–6 years of software development experience, with hands-on experience in full stack development using ReactJS and Python. 
Skills 
- Strong expertise in ReactJS, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. 

- Proficiency in Python and backend frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask. 

- Experience with REST APIs; familiarity with GraphQL is a plus. 

- Experience with frontend state management solutions such as Redux, Context API, React Query, or Zustand. 

- Database management experience with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar SQL/NoSQL databases. 

- Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and microservices architecture. 

- Hands-on experience deploying and managing applications using GCP, AWS, or Azure. 

- Infrastructure as Code (IaC) skills with Terraform and Helm. 

- Understanding of unit testing, API testing, code reviews, and secure coding practices. 

- Familiarity with Figma, responsive design, accessibility standards, and cross-browser compatibility.

Education 
Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

What We Offer 
- Opportunity to lead cutting-edge AI projects in a global consulting environment. 

- Leadership development programs and training sessions at our global centers. 

- A dynamic and collaborative team environment with diverse projects. 

Position based in Mumbai (onsite)

title: Software Engineer, Backend  (3-5 years)
description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer with 3 to 5 years of experience to join our engineering team. In this role, you will play a critical part in designing and building robust, highly scalable distributed systems. You will collaborate closely with product leadership, mentor junior team members, and take immense ownership of complex technical challenges in a fast-paced environment.
Key Responsibilities
- System Architecture & Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable web-based applications. Create architectural abstractions and technical contracts with a strict adherence to the separation of concerns.

- Problem Solving & High-Level Design: Drive solutions for high-level business and technical problems. Lead functional modeling, module decomposition, and system design initiatives.

- Architectural Evolution: Implement incremental changes to the existing architecture and conduct comprehensive impact analyses.

- Performance Optimization: Profile, tune, and improve performance across large-scale distributed systems.

- Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate closely with Product Managers to translate business features into technical capabilities. Lead the execution of medium-sized projects and structure workflows into distinct phases to ensure predictable delivery.

- Stakeholder Alignment: Work with broader stakeholders to track the impact of deployed projects and features, proactively iterating on them for continuous improvement.

- Mentorship: Mentor junior engineers, foster a collaborative team culture, and promote engineering excellence.

Required Qualifications
- Education: B.Tech, M.Tech, or Ph.D. in Computer Science or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

- Experience: 3 to 5 years of professional experience in software engineering, with a proven track record of solving problems at scale.

- Programming Expertise: Extensive experience in at least one general-purpose programming language (e.g., Java, C, C++). Exceptional coding skills with the ability to fluently translate design into maintainable, scalable, and unit-tested code.

- Concurrency: Strong hands-on experience with multi-threading and concurrent programming.

- System Design: Deep expertise in Object-Oriented Design (OOD), design patterns, and building intuitive module and class-level interfaces.

- Scale & Data Management: Proven experience building highly scalable business applications, handling complex business flows, and processing massive volumes of data.

- Database Proficiency: Solid understanding of relational databases (e.g., MySQL) as well as NoSQL technologies (e.g., HBase, Elasticsearch, Aerospike).

- Engineering Best Practices: Strong knowledge of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and experience with the full software development life cycle (SDLC) on a Linux platform.

- Working Environment: Demonstrated ability to thrive in a high-growth, dynamic startup environment with high levels of ownership and commitment.

- Drive & Passion: A strong analytical mindset with a genuine passion for solving complex, real-world technical challenges.

PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)
Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy
Our inclusive culture promotes individual expression, creativity, innovation, and achievement and in turn helps us better understand and serve our customers. We see ourselves as a place for intellectual curiosity, ideas and debates, where diverse perspectives lead to deeper understanding and better quality results. title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is building a next-generation artifact management platform for internal libraries and build artifacts. This platform is a critical part of OCI’s build, deployment, and security patching workflows across internal service teams.

As a Senior Software Developer, you will help design and build a scalable, highly available, and reliable artifact management system for OCI. You will own key components of systems that manage, migrate, update, replicate, and serve build artifacts at OCI scale. You will work closely with service teams, CI/CD stakeholders, and platform partners to support smooth integration, operational resilience, and long-term scalability.

Qualifications

Proven experience building scalable distributed systems.

Strong background in cloud infrastructure; Oracle Cloud Infrastructure experience is a plus.

Experience with CI/CD systems, artifact repositories, build systems, or developer productivity platforms.

Experience with data migration, data consistency, and production rollout strategies.

Strong ownership, technical judgment, collaboration, and mentoring skills.

As an individual contributor, you will play a key role in developing OCI’s Artifact Management System and migrating artifacts from legacy systems. This role requires strong hands-on engineering depth, sound technical judgment, and the ability to collaborate across teams on complex platform initiatives.
Key responsibilities include:
Architecture and Implementation: Design and implement scalable service components capable of handling high request volume, large artifact datasets, and strict availability requirements.
Large-Scale Migration: Contribute to strategies and tooling for migrating large volumes of historical artifacts from legacy systems to the new platform while maintaining data consistency, integrity, and minimal customer impact.
CI/CD Integration: Build and support integrations between the artifact management platform and OCI’s CI/CD workflows and deployment systems.
Technical Ownership: Own key technical areas, participate in design discussions, make well-reasoned implementation decisions, mentor less experienced engineers, and provide high-quality code and design reviews.
Operational Excellence: Contribute to monitoring, alerting, rollout, disaster recovery, and reliability practices to ensure the platform operates safely at OCI scale.
Continuous Improvement: Analyze adoption, usage patterns, performance, and operational gaps, and drive improvements that increase scalability, reliability, and customer experience.

Career Level - IC3

title: Senior Software Engineer I
description:
The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company’s growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed. We support the delivery and operations of technology, digital, and data capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, our team is responsible for the company’s technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality experience for customers and colleagues. We also provide product management for core enterprise platforms, and lead technology risk and information security, enterprise data governance and platforms, digital product and design, and enterprise AI platforms on behalf of the company.
Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success. Because Amex Tech is powered by our technology, our culture, and our colleagues. 
The Technology organization enables and accelerates the company’s growth strategies, delivering global capabilities and services in support of Amex’s customers and colleagues, while maintaining 24/7 servicing and availability to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality customer experience. Technology provides the foundation for everything we do in the company while driving differentiation through building and leveraging innovative technology and data insights.
The Global Merchant and Network Services Technology (GMNST) organization at American Express is responsible for modernizing the payments network to enable next-generation payments products. The team creates flexible merchant platforms to acquire, bill, pay, service and foster innovation, while enabling a payments ecosystem to connect and authenticate parties seamlessly and securely
As a Software Quality Engineer, you will join our Global Merchant and Network Services Technology team that has embarked on building a highly available and scalable distributed systems on the cloud to support the company's long-term strategy and vision. Your primary role includes driving execution across multiple Scrum teams, ensuring product backlog priorities are clearly defined, aligned to stakeholder needs, and delivered with high quality.
Key Initiatives:
- Card Network Authorizations/Routing, Clearing and Settlement.
- ATM, Debit, Credit and Push Payment Transactions.
- Platform Engineering and Foundational Capabilities of distributed systems 
- High Availability, Resiliency and Performance Engineering on Cloud

- Define and drive the quality engineering strategy, architecture, standards, and roadmap for large-scale, distributed, mission-critical payment platforms.
- Provide technical leadership across multiple engineering teams, influencing architecture, solution design, development practices, testing strategies, and production readiness.
- Architect, design, and develop scalable automation frameworks, platforms, tooling, and reusable quality engineering capabilities supporting functional, API, integration, system, regression, end-to-end, resiliency, and performance testing.
- Remain hands-on with engineering by developing automation solutions, reviewing code, creating proof-of-concepts, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and solving systemic quality challenges.
- Partner with architects and senior engineers during architecture and design reviews to identify quality, scalability, reliability, testability, and operational risks early in the development lifecycle.
- Establish and champion shift-left, continuous testing, testability, and quality-by-design principles throughout the software development lifecycle.
- Define enterprise-grade testing approaches for distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures, transactional platforms, and complex system integrations.
- Develop strategies for validating high-volume financial transactions, including authorization, routing, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, and data integrity across distributed systems.
- Lead quality engineering efforts for high availability, resiliency, failover, disaster recovery, scalability, and performance of mission-critical platforms.
- Establish automated quality gates and integrate comprehensive testing capabilities into CI/CD pipelines to enable reliable and frequent software delivery.
- Define and evolve quality metrics, engineering scorecards, test coverage models, observability strategies, release readiness criteria, and production quality indicators.
- Leverage production telemetry, monitoring, logging, and observability capabilities to proactively identify quality risks and improve system reliability.
- Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis of complex production and pre-production issues spanning application, infrastructure, cloud, database, messaging, and integration layers.
- Identify systemic engineering and quality gaps and drive long-term solutions rather than point-in-time fixes.
- Evaluate emerging technologies, open-source frameworks, AI-assisted engineering capabilities, and industry practices to continuously evolve the organization's quality engineering capabilities.
- Collaborate with engineering, product management, architecture, DevOps/SRE, security, and operations teams to ensure successful delivery of highly scalable and resilient platforms.
- Provide technical mentorship and guidance to Quality Engineers and Software Engineers, raising engineering standards and strengthening quality engineering capabilities across teams.
- Influence engineering leaders and stakeholders across organizational boundaries and drive alignment on quality priorities, technical investments, risks, and remediation strategies.
- Lead quality engineering for complex, cross-functional initiatives involving globally distributed engineering teams and multiple dependent platforms.
- Champion a culture where quality, reliability, performance, and operational excellence are shared engineering responsibilities.

- 10+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering, Software Development in Test (SDET), Quality Engineering, Test Automation, or related engineering disciplines, including significant experience providing technical leadership for complex software platforms.
- 5+ years of experience in Payments, Banking, FinTech, Financial Services, Card Networks, or other high-volume transactional environments strongly preferred.
- Deep understanding of payment processing concepts such as authorization, routing, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, ATM, debit, credit, and push-payment processing is highly desirable.
- Advanced programming skills in Java, Python, or comparable object-oriented programming languages, with demonstrated experience building production-quality automation frameworks, engineering tools, or test platforms.
- Proven experience architecting and implementing scalable automation frameworks and reusable testing capabilities for APIs, microservices, distributed systems, integration, and end-to-end workflows.
- Extensive hands-on experience with API and service testing technologies such as Rest Assured, Karate, Postman, or equivalent frameworks.
- Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture, including microservices, asynchronous/event-driven processing, messaging, APIs, databases, caching, and service-to-service integrations.
- Strong SQL and data engineering/testing skills, with demonstrated experience validating complex transactional workflows and high-volume financial datasets.
- Extensive experience designing automated testing strategies and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines using modern DevOps and software delivery practices.
- Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures and experience validating applications deployed on public or private cloud platforms.
- Demonstrated experience with reliability, resiliency, scalability, performance, failover, disaster recovery, and high-availability testing for mission-critical systems.
- Hands-on experience with monitoring, logging, tracing, and observability platforms such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, Grafana, or equivalent technologies.
- Experience supporting and troubleshooting high-volume, business-critical production systems with stringent availability and reliability requirements.
- Demonstrated ability to assess complex architectures, identify systemic quality and operational risks, and influence engineering teams toward effective technical solutions.
- Proven track record of leading quality engineering initiatives spanning multiple teams, platforms, and organizational boundaries.
- Strong understanding of Agile engineering practices and experience delivering large, complex, cross-functional technology initiatives.
- Exceptional analytical, debugging, problem-solving, and root cause analysis capabilities, with the ability to navigate complex distributed-system failures.
- Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, establish engineering standards, influence technical direction, and drive organizational adoption of quality engineering best practices.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts and risks effectively to engineers, architects, product leaders, and senior technology stakeholders.
- Strong ownership mindset with a passion for engineering excellence, automation, operational reliability, continuous improvement, and customer-centric delivery.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline preferred.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Okta's Identity Governance (OIG) organization is looking for a Staff Engineer to join our Identity Administration team — a team that is directly responsible for one of the most critical and visible workflows in enterprise identity: how employees request, approve, and gain access to the resources they need. 

Opportunity

title: Software Development Engineer, Finance Technology
description:
We are responsible for billions of dollars of payments each month to millions of Amazon vendors across the globe. We delight our vendors by paying them when they want and how they want, accurately and on time.

We build software applications that facilitate global financial transactions worth billions (USD) annually, rivaling the complexity and scope of dedicated payments fintech companies. Our systems decide how and when a payment happens, carry it out across the world's payment networks, and account for it — all under real regulatory, tax, and audit obligations, in every geography Amazon operates in.

You will have the opportunity to work in a high-paced environment leveraging the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) within our core principles of engineering, to deliver faster and ship features incrementally.

Ownership is the center of this role, and ownership here means the whole lifecycle rather than just the code. You will take features from working backwards from the customer through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and documentation — and you stay accountable for how they behave in production long after they ship.

Own features and components of our payment systems end-to-end. The business problem and the technology direction will be understood; how to actually build it will not be, and that part is yours.
Design the solution and make the tradeoffs. You will code independently, and you will have senior and principal engineers to pull in when a tradeoff is genuinely hard or when a design needs to line up with where the architecture is heading.
Work directly with product managers and business stakeholders — finance, tax, and accounts payable operations — to understand what they need and why, so that you build the right thing. You will hear the requirement first-hand rather than through a written hand-off, and you will be expected to push back when the ask and the outcome do not line up.
Ship incrementally. Large payment changes land safely through staged rollout and measurement, not through a single release.
Reduce operational load. Our best work turns a recurring manual intervention into a code fix or a self-healing mechanism, not another runbook step.
Leave the system better explained than you found it. What you build should be maintainable and extensible by an engineer who has never seen it, which means clear documentation and design choices that hold up without you in the room.
Raise the bar around you: code review as a teaching mechanism, mentoring engineers earlier in their careers, and getting new teammates productive on how our software is built, how it operates, and how it fits into the bigger picture.

Building with agentic AI
We are not experimenting with AI on the side — it is how we work. You will use AI agents across the development lifecycle: exploring unfamiliar systems, drafting and reviewing designs, generating and testing code, triaging production issues, and automating the operational work that used to consume a week of on-call. We expect engineers to be strong directors of these agents and rigorous verifiers of their output. The judgment stays with you: you are accountable for what ships, whether you typed it or an agent did. Agentic capabilities are increasingly part of the systems themselves — automating decisions and investigations that previously required a human in the loop — and you will have room to build them.

Why this team
Payments is one of the few places in software where the business logic is genuinely hard, the scale is enormous, and a mistake has an immediate real-world consequence — a vendor who does not get paid when they expected. If you want real ownership, global scope, and the freedom to build with the newest tools available rather than waiting for permission to try them, this is a good place to build a career.

You will own systems end to end: from design and implementation to production operation and debugging. The weight is on the backend, but you are expected to build and own the interfaces that sit on top of it.

This is a hands-on role with technical leadership responsibilities. Alongside your own delivery, you will lead the design of larger workstreams and help grow the engineers around you.

About The Team

Converse is LeadSquared's conversation platform. It comprises the agent-facing chat applications and the underlying channel layer that delivers messages across an expanding portfolio of communication channels.

Converse is shared infrastructure. Several LeadSquared products depend on it for message delivery, including products unrelated to chat. As a result, interface contracts, backward compatibility, and availability are first-order concerns.

Core Responsibilities

- Design, build, and operate high-throughput, event-driven, multi-tenant backend services and the interfaces on top of them. 
- Own the platform's integration surface: external messaging providers, the pipelines behind them, and the cost of onboarding each new provider. 
- Own correctness, observability, and running costs across your area, including multi-tenancy, encryption, and regulatory requirements that vary by market. 
- Lead the technical design of larger workstreams and break them into work that other engineers can execute independently. 
- Mentor senior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and pairing. 
- Set and uphold engineering standards for the team across design, testing, and operational readiness. 
- Own architecture and technical direction for your area and represent the team in cross-team discussions. 

 Expected Candidate Profile 

- 6+ years of experience building and operating production backend services, with depth in distributed, event-driven architecture. 
- Strong proficiency in at least one server-side language — Node.js/TypeScript, Java, Go, or C# — and the ability to work effectively across unfamiliar technology stacks. 
- Strong React and TypeScript skills, with production experience owning user-facing interfaces, including real-time or event-driven applications. 
- Strong experience designing APIs and data models that other teams build on. 
- A track record of leading the design and delivery of workstreams spanning several engineers. 
- Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar of a team. 
- Ability to make architectural decisions, defend them, and change position when the argument warrants it. 
- Accountability for code you did not write by hand, including code produced with AI assistance. 

 Preferred Experience 

- Experience with messaging, CPaaS, or communication platforms: WhatsApp Business API, SMS aggregators, push services, or telephony. 
- Experience with third-party provider integration or middleware at scale. 
- Depth in more than one backend ecosystem, such as the JVM alongside Node.js. 
- Deep AWS expertise and experience with streaming platforms such as Kafka, Pulsar, Kinesis, or Redis Streams. 
- Experience with multi-tenant SaaS and regulated or compliance-sensitive systems. 
- Experience in reliability engineering, observability, and cloud cost optimisation at scale. 
- Experience taking a system from its first implementation to a platform that other teams depend on. 
- Experience growing engineers into independent owners of significant systems. 
- Experience leading technical evaluations of external providers and contributing to technical hiring. 

 Technology Environment 

Backend

Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, Express, Serverless Framework, Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud Gateway, Micronaut, OpenFeign, Resilience4J, jOOQ

Data

MySQL, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, Redis

Messaging And Streaming

Kafka, Pulsar, Redis Streams, Kinesis, SQS/SNS

Infrastructure

AWS Lambda, EKS, Batch, API Gateway, KMS, S3, CloudFront, Docker, Helm, Bitbucket Pipelines

Frontend

React 18, Preact, TypeScript, Signals, micro-frontends, WebSockets, Web Workers

About The Opportunity

This is a platform engineering role. The systems are used by several LeadSquared products and are subject to external constraints from platform providers, telecom regulators, and carriers. The problems center on scale, correctness, and reliability.

The leadership here is exercised first through design, review, and mentoring. How the role develops from there depends on the person in it.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Department: Tech - Software Engineering
Location: Gurugram, India

Description

The Interfaces to Aurora

Aurora is the global market leader in energy market analytics and software. We built that position on fundamentals models of energy markets and the intellectual rigour behind them. Investors, lenders, developers and governments use our forecasts to decide which wind farms, solar farms and batteries get built and financed, so the data has to be trusted and bankable. None of that matters unless people can get at it.

Our Product Engineering team owns the interfaces to Aurora: UI, APIs, SDKs, CLIs and newer interaction models such as MCP servers, which let AI agents work with our data directly. Our job is to make Aurora's capabilities usable for customers and our own analysts, whatever the touchpoint, and everyone in the team works across those surfaces.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join one of our squads in our growing Gurugram engineering hub.

What Makes It Interesting

Energy sits where physics, economics and maths meet. A power price emerges from weather, grid constraints, fuel costs, policy and the behaviour of every asset on the system, and our models simulate all of it. Our modellers build those models, but our engineers engage just as deeply with the domain. You can't design a good interface to something you don't understand, so you'll learn how markets, assets and policy fit together, and for most of the team that's a big part of the appeal. You don't need an energy background to apply: we'll support you to build that knowledge.

The harder engineering problem is that there is no single energy market. Our regional teams cover markets around the world, and a market rule in Texas, a capacity mechanism in Germany and a grid in Australia all have to be handled by the same software. Designing something that respects those differences without dissolving into special cases is where much of the interesting work sits.

Key Responsibilities

We're organised into long-lived squads, each owning part of the product end to end, with an embedded product representative who can make backlog decisions. Squads stay stable so they build real depth in their area.

We are serious about continuous delivery and push to production many times a day in small changes, backed by automated tests and CI. We already tick most of the DORA capabilities (the practices research has found predict good software delivery outcomes), and we treat that as a starting point. Our ambition is to be among the best engineering teams at building and delivering software. You'll own what you build from design through to running it in production.

AI tools are expected across the whole job: requirements, design, code, tests, review and operations. Our stance is fundamentals first. AI amplifies whatever practice it sits on, so it makes good engineering faster and bad engineering faster too. What we care about is how you frame a problem, break it down and verify what comes back.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required attributes:- You will build and ship software that real people use, and be able to explain your choices, including the ones you'd now make differently
- care about tests, readable code and what happens to your work after it's merged
- enjoy understanding a problem as much as solving it, and be curious about a domain you may not know yet
- use AI tools in your work, and have views on where they help and where they don't
- want to get noticeably better over the next couple of years, and be someone others enjoy working with along the way
Our stack is TypeScript and Node, Express, React micro-frontends, SQL (Redshift and MySQL) and MongoDB on AWS, with some Python. Experience with it helps but isn't required: some of our strongest engineers came from C# and other stacks, because good engineering transfers.

What we offer

Some of the benefits we include are:- Accidental, term life and medical insurance
- Hybrid Work model
- Employee’s Provident Fund Scheme
- Maternity leave
- A fun, informal, collaborative and international work culture
- Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills within the responsibilities of your role and within the wider context of the industry.
- Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), offering a complete support network that offers expert advice and compassionate guidance 24/7/365, covering a wide range of personal and professional aspects
The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavorable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity.

To apply, please submit your Résumé / CV, a personal summary, your salary expectations and please inform us of your notice period.

Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications via email, telephone, or social media platforms. To be considered for this position, please submit your application using the link provided. Applications submitted through any other channel will not be reviewed.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Product & AI
description:
About CultureMonkey
CultureMonkey is an employee engagement platform used by enterprise companies around the world, including the EU. HR teams and leaders run surveys on it, read the results and decide what to fix. We are a small engineering team, so every engineer owns real features and ships them to production.

The problems you'll work on
- Anonymity on real HR data. Survey answers have to stay anonymous. Nobody should be able to work out who said what, even by combining filters, comparing groups or getting around minimum group sizes. Getting this right takes care with every report, export and API.
- Ask Cooper, our AI assistant. Ask Cooper is an LLM assistant that answers leaders' questions about their own survey data. You'll improve how it reasons, which tools it can call, how it is scoped for each role, and how we measure whether its answers are right.
- Security and privacy for global clients. Enterprise customers, including EU clients, check how we handle their data. You'll build features that hold up to their security reviews.

What you'll do

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

Aon plc (NYSE: AON) is a leading global professional services firm providing a broad range of risk, retirement and health solutions. This role is based in the Analytics Products team and is a Level 8 position on the AON Career Framework, designed for early-career talent looking to build a career in data analytics.

You will support senior team members in the delivery of analytics projects using Aon's suite of analytical tools (Tableau, Power BI etc.), supported by our data warehouse (Databricks), while developing your technical and business skills under guidance.

About The Role

As an Associate Software Engineer within the Assessment Solutions business, you will start your engineering career building real features on the Aon Assessment Platform — the enterprise solution for accurate and fair workforce assessments at scale, used by millions of participants worldwide.

You will join one of our international engineering squads (Germany and India), working under the guidance of your Software Engineering Team Lead and senior engineers on your team. You'll be given real, well-scoped pieces of work — not busywork — and the support to grow quickly: pairing, code review, and structured feedback are part of how the team operates day to day.

This is a strong platform to learn on. Our codebase is large and touches many interconnected components, so you'll build not just coding skill but the habit of thinking carefully about how a change affects the wider system — a skill that compounds over your whole career.

Key Responsibilities

Feature Implementation

- Implement well-scoped features, bug fixes, and enhancements under the guidance of your Team Lead and senior engineers.
- Write clean, tested code across the stack — C#/.NET services, SQL Server data access, and React front-ends — following established patterns and standards.
- Break down assigned tasks into clear implementation steps, asking clarifying questions early rather than guessing at ambiguous requirements.
- Fix defects identified by QA or reported in production, learning to diagnose root causes rather than just patching symptoms.

Quality & Testing

- Write unit and integration tests for the code you deliver, as a core part of "done" rather than an optional extra.
- Participate in code reviews — both receiving feedback and, as you grow, reviewing the work of peers.
- Follow the team's engineering standards: layered architecture, API design conventions, and our React corporate design system.
- Verify your own changes thoroughly before raising them for review, including checking for obvious edge cases.

Learning & Growth

- Actively build your understanding of the platform's architecture, data model, and key components — asking questions and using documentation, pairing, and code reading to ramp up.
- Seek and act on feedback from code reviews, 1:1s, and pairing sessions — treating early mistakes as part of the learning process.
- Build foundational skills in requirements analysis, technical design, and estimation by working alongside more senior engineers on real tasks.

Collaboration

- Work closely with your Team Lead, senior engineers, QA, and Business Analysts as part of daily squad activities (stand-ups, planning, reviews).
- Communicate progress, blockers, and questions clearly and early — this is more valuable at this stage than trying to solve everything independently.
- Contribute positively to an international team culture, working comfortably with colleagues across time zones.

AI-Augmented Engineering

- Use AI tools in your day-to-day work — for learning, coding assistance, debugging, and documentation — under guidance from senior engineers, building good habits for using them effectively and responsibly. This is a core expectation, not a nice-to-have.

Required Skills & Experience

- 0–1 year of professional software engineering experience (2025 or 2026 passout only)
- Solid foundation in programming fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design, gained through coursework, internships, or personal projects.
- Some exposure to C#/.NET, SQL, JavaScript, or React — through study, internships, or personal projects; we will invest in deepening this on the job.
- Basic understanding of relational databases and SQL querying.
- Strong problem-solving ability and eagerness to learn — comfortable asking questions and receiving direct feedback.
- Good written and verbal communication skills, comfortable working in an international team across time zones.
- A genuine interest in using AI tools to learn and work more effectively. This is a core expectation, not a nice-to-have.

Eligibility Criteria

title: Software Engineer II - Product Data Gateway
description:

At Abnormal AI, we are on a thrilling mission to safeguard the world's largest enterprises against a vast range of relentless email and collaboration application cyber security attacks. Our relentless pursuit involves crafting an exceptional suite of products that empowers customers to seamlessly visualize, expertly control, and fearlessly combat cyber-security threats.

The Multi-Product Platform (MPP) organization owns the product platform that enables scalable product development, helping the business build and launch enterprise-grade products with a consistent customer experience.

This is a chance to build the data backbone that every Abnormal product depends on. As a Software Engineer on MPP, you'll create the standardised data layer that becomes our single source of truth — the one governed path through which any system, agent, or interface can reach data from across every product, from a single record to cross-product aggregates, online or offline, in whatever shape it needs. It's a genuinely hard, high-leverage problem: the layer has to serve the entire platform at high throughput and low latency without ever becoming the bottleneck, while enforcing tenant isolation, authentication, and fine-grained access control so every team inherits strong security and reliability for free. You won't be maintaining someone else's system — you'll be defining the foundation every product is built on, where getting it right compounds across the whole company.

Technical Delivery & Operational Excellence

- Own the reliability and stability of the components and features you build.

Must Have Skills

- Software Engineer with 4+ years of industry experience and strong software engineering fundamentals.
- Growth-oriented, looking to increase impact, responsibility, and ownership over time.
- Proven ability to own complex problems and multi-component features end-to-end, with a growing ability to collaborate and influence across teams.

title: Software Development Engineer 4
description:
Job Title

Software Development Engineer 4

About The Role

CPS (Payment Operations & Risk Control) part of Money Movement, oversees payment operations, transaction risk controls, and merchant and acquirer whitelisting. As a Senior Software Engineer 4, you'll design, build and run the systems that keep transactions flowing safely. That includes risk rules and controls, merchant and acquirer (MID) whitelisting and blocking, and operational tools for the teams who monitor them. You'll be the technical reference for the team, mentor developers, and work with Architects, Product Management, Product Definition and Operations to deliver secure, scalable, compliant solutions.

Common Accountabilities

- Has working experience and advanced, specialised technical and functional knowledge in own discipline. Understands how own area contributes to the business. Acts as a reference for less experienced colleagues and supports junior team members.
- Influences decisions related to own activity, anticipates dependencies and consequences in complex scenarios, contributes to cross-team projects, proposes process improvements, and is accountable for own and team commitments.
- Works independently within the plan set by the manager, with some guidance in the most complex situations.

Specific Accountabilities

- Analyse specifications
- Define user requirements for developing new software solutions or upgrading existing ones.
- Turn business and operational needs for payment operations and risk control into technical solutions.
- Size development work and help slice stories into deliverable increments.
- Design systems and code
- Design technical solutions and carry out feasibility studies for transaction risk controls, merchant and acquirer whitelisting, and payment operations features.
- Propose workable technical solutions to Product Management and/or users for validation.
- Work with Architects on scalable, resilient, high-availability, low-latency designs, and propose system improvements.
- Develop software to Amadeus standards, with security, auditability and PCI-DSS compliance built in from the start.
- Model, design and implement databases, including reference and configuration data such as merchant and acquirer lists and risk rules.
- Test and validate
- Run unit, package, integration and performance tests, and keep quality in line with Amadeus guidelines (SonarQube quality gates, Black Duck compliance).
- Take part in the product validation phase and fine-tune where needed to finalise the product.
- Review code and promote clean code practices, including spotting code smells and handling memory leaks.
- Maintain and optimise
- Troubleshoot and investigate defects raised by customers, so the products meet their specifications and the system stays intact.
- Debug efficiently and resolve production issues quickly, including transaction issues, risk-control incidents and urgent merchant or acquirer whitelisting and blocking requests.
- Run routine performance analysis and optimise the software.
- Collaborate
- Work closely with Product Management, Technical Business Analysts, Quality Assurance and Global Operations to deliver high-quality code for internal and external customers that works and matches the requirements documents.
- Collaborate with team members, learn from their knowledge and different backgrounds, and bring your own strengths to the team.
- Coordinate development across teams and areas with other teams and developers.
- Document your work
- Create and update standardised documentation, including software documentation, operational runbooks and risk-control configuration guides, and share it with the requesting departments.

Technical Expertise

Must-have

- Java and microservices development.
- Distributed systems, cloud-native technologies and containers (Kubernetes).
- Monitoring, alerting and observability tools for production operations.
- Strong object-oriented design and programming in C++, including advanced concepts, OOAD and design patterns.
- Working knowledge of Python.
- Scalable architecture; developing complex algorithms (for example rule evaluation or rule engines); memory management and memory-leak analysis.
- Strong debugging, troubleshooting and performance-optimisation skills, including in production.
- Development in Unix/Linux, with Shell scripting.
- Relational or NoSQL databases and their use.
- Writing good unit tests; experience with at least one testing framework.
- Version control and CI/CD (Git/GitHub/Bitbucket, Jenkins); awareness of SonarQube and Black Duck.
- Web services and API design and troubleshooting (REST and SOAP).
- Hands-on practice with Agile methods: Scrum is required.

Functional / Domain Knowledge

Strongly Preferred

- Payment operations: the transaction lifecycle (authorisation, capture, refunds, chargebacks) and the roles of merchants, acquirers, processors and schemes.
- Transaction risk control: fraud and risk rules, velocity checks, limits, and blocking and whitelisting.
- Merchant and acquirer onboarding, MID management and whitelisting or blocklisting processes.

Good to have

- Knowledge of existing Amadeus/Outpayce payment products.
- ISO 8583 messaging and 3DS.
- Knowledge of PCI-DSS and GDPR.
- SAFe,Angular,
- Exposure to the travel domain.

Required Skills And Experience

- Education: Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering (Software Development).
- 9+ years of software development experience, across the full product development lifecycle including production support.
- Can lead a team of strong developers and develop their talent.
- Delivers high-quality results in a fast-paced, changing environment with shifting priorities, and consistently meets deadlines.
- Keeps status reports up to date on projects, technical problems and risks, and other relevant details.
- Clear communication and presentation skills, and builds good relationships with stakeholders.
- Understands business and operational requirements and turns them into technical solutions; sees the big picture from the user's, operations' and the business's point of view.

title: Lead - Fullstack
description:
Lead Software Engineer – Full Stack

Department: Engineering
Role type: Full-time

About Rocketlane

Rocketlane is building world-class software for customer onboarding, professional services, and modern service delivery teams.

We care deeply about product craft. Our engineers work closely with Product and Design to solve complex problems, build delightful user experiences, and create systems that remain fast and reliable as we scale.

If you enjoy owning a problem end-to-end — from the database and APIs all the way to the interactions a customer sees in the browser — this role is for you.

What will you do?

As a Lead Full Stack Engineer, you will own meaningful parts of the Rocketlane product from design through production.

You will:
- Design and build features end-to-end across our React frontend and Java backend.
- Work closely with Product and Design to turn customer problems into simple, thoughtful product experiences.
- Build polished, performant user experiences for complex SaaS workflows.
- Design clean APIs, data models, and backend services that can scale as our customers and usage grow.
- Solve challenging product problems involving real-time collaboration, rich interactive experiences, workflow automation, large datasets, and highly configurable enterprise use cases.
- Make thoughtful architectural decisions across frontend, backend, database, caching, and asynchronous processing.
- Own the performance and reliability of what you build — from browser performance through API latency and database queries.
- Debug complex issues across the entire stack rather than stopping at service boundaries.
- Write maintainable, well-tested code and raise the quality bar through thoughtful code reviews.
- Identify technical debt and proactively improve architecture, developer experience, observability, and engineering productivity.
- Mentor engineers and help the team make better technical decisions.
- Take ownership of features in production and work with the team to diagnose and resolve issues quickly.
- Participate actively in engineering design discussions and influence how Rocketlane's technology evolves.
You should apply if

Frontend

You are comfortable with:
- React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript
- SPA architecture and component design
- HTML and CSS
- State management and complex client-side application flows
- Browser fundamentals such as caching, storage, networking, and rendering
- Building reusable components and maintainable frontend architecture
- Frontend performance profiling and optimization
- Building responsive and high-quality product experiences
Experience with real-time applications, WebSockets, large data-heavy interfaces, rich editors, or spreadsheet-like experiences is a plus.

Backend

You have strong fundamentals in:
- Java and Spring or similar backend frameworks
- HTTP and REST API design
- PostgreSQL or other relational databases
- Data modelling and query performance
- Redis and caching
- Asynchronous processing and message brokers
- Designing scalable and resilient backend services
- Performance optimization
- Debugging and root-cause analysis
- Logging, monitoring, and production troubleshooting
Engineering fundamentals

Beyond knowing frameworks, we expect you to understand why systems behave the way they do.

You should be comfortable discussing topics such as:
- API and system design
- Database transactions and concurrency
- Caching strategies
- Distributed systems fundamentals
- Failure handling and resiliency
- Performance and scalability
- Security and authorization
- Testing strategy
- Production observability
- Clean code and maintainable architecture
What we're really looking for

We're not looking for someone who is 50% frontend and 50% backend but shallow in both.

We're looking for an engineer who has strong depth in at least one part of the stack, solid engineering fundamentals across the other, and the ability to independently take a customer problem from:

Problem → Design → Architecture → Backend → Frontend → Production

You should be someone who asks:

“What is the right solution for the customer and the product?”

rather than:

“Is this a frontend problem or a backend problem?”

You'll thrive here if
- You enjoy owning problems rather than just completing tickets.
- You care about both how a product works and how it feels to use.
- You can move quickly without compromising engineering fundamentals.
- You are comfortable working through ambiguity and breaking large problems into smaller ones.
- You enjoy collaborating directly with Product and Design.
- You are willing to dive into unfamiliar parts of the stack when the problem requires it.
- You care about performance, reliability, and maintainability — not just getting something to work.
- You enjoy mentoring other engineers while remaining deeply hands-on.
- You like learning, experimenting, and continuously improving the way software is built.
Nice to have
- Experience building B2B SaaS products
- Experience in a startup or high-growth product company
- AWS experience
- Docker/containerization experience
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines
- Experience building real-time collaborative applications
- Experience with WebSockets
- Experience working with high-volume APIs or large datasets
- Experience with Playwright, Cypress, or similar automation frameworks
- Experience designing enterprise-grade integrations
- Exposure to AI-assisted product development or AI-powered product experiences
Why Rocketlane?

Build challenging product experiences

You'll work on problems that go well beyond basic CRUD applications — collaborative workflows, highly interactive interfaces, automation, data-heavy experiences, enterprise integrations, and increasingly AI-powered experiences.

Own meaningful parts of the product

Engineers at Rocketlane are expected to understand the problem, contribute to the solution, build it, ship it, and learn from how customers use it.

Work across boundaries

You won't be constrained by artificial frontend/backend boundaries. If solving the problem requires changing the UI, API, data model, cache, or infrastructure, you'll have the opportunity to work across all of them.

Raise your engineering bar

You'll work alongside engineers, designers, and product leaders who care deeply about building a world-class SaaS product.

And most importantly, you'll have the opportunity to look at something customers use every day and say:

“I built that.”

description:
Hybrid, Bangalore or Pune, India 

JOB OVERVIEW

The Legion application is a high-performance, data-driven Java enterprise application that implements sophisticated scheduling and optimization algorithms. It also provides the necessary endpoints for our Web and mobile frontend applications.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

As a Full Stack Senior Software Engineer, you will be a member of the team responsible for the implementation and evolution of this application. You will need to be able to write secure, efficient, enterprise-quality code, and have a deep understanding of the techniques and technologies that are necessary for scalability and performance.

- Design, build, and ship features end to end across the backend (Java / Spring Boot services, REST APIs, data model) and the web frontend (React / AngularJS).
- Write secure, efficient, enterprise-quality code that scales to large multi-location customers with complex, highly configurable setups.
- Own the performance of what you build: diagnose slow queries, memory pressure, and large data imports/exports, and fix them at the root cause.
- Keep backend and UI behavior consistent — the API contract, validation, and what the user sees must agree.
- Write unit and integration tests, review peers' code, and hold a high bar on quality and maintainability.
- Write technical design documents for non-trivial changes and break them into incremental, shippable pieces.
- Investigate and resolve production issues using logs, metrics, and tracing; take part in on-call and escalation support for your area.
- Work closely with Product, QA, and Customer Success to clarify requirements and validate fixes with customers.
- Mentor engineers on the team and raise the technical bar through reviews and design discussions.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping software products (not consulting or website/portal development).
- Strong backend experience in Java with Spring Boot, Hibernate/JPA, and REST API design.
- Strong frontend experience with React or AngularJS, plus JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3, including cross-browser compatibility.
- Solid relational database skills with MySQL (or similar): schema design, indexing, query tuning, and migrations.
- Experience with performance and scalability work: profiling, memory and allocation issues, batching, caching, and asynchronous/queue-based processing.
- Experience handling the complexity of many configurations in a multi-tenant, cloud-based product.
- Experience with AWS and containerized deployments.
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a similar field.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.

We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.

Benefits include, but are not limited to:

- Health Benefits
- Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
- Parental Leave 
- Equity 
- Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
- Monthly Lunch on Legion

ABOUT LEGION

Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love.

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.

BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY 

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.

For more information, visit https://legion.co

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.

DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION

For individuals with disabilities who need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email recruiting@legion.co

We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Legion recruiting email communications will always come from the @legion.co domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Legion via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Legion employee, reach out to recruiting@legion.co

Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

How We Determine What We Pay

As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay.

Job Applicant Privacy Policy

This Job Applicant Privacy Policy (“Policy”) describes how Legion Technologies, Inc. (“Legion”, “we”, “us” and “our”) collects, uses, and discloses “personal information” as defined under California law from and about job applicants who are residents of California.

This Policy does not apply to our handling of data gathered about you in your role as a user of our consumer-facing services. When you interact with us as in that role, the Legion Privacy Policy applies.

- Types of Personal Information We Handle

We collect, store, and use various types of personal information through the application and recruitment process. We collect such information either directly from you or (where applicable) from another person or entity, such as an employment agency or consultancy, background check provider, or other referral sources. This information includes:

- Identification and contact information, and related identifiers such as full name, date and place of birth, citizenship and permanent residence, home and business addresses, telephone numbers, email addresses, and such information about your beneficiaries or emergency contacts.
- Professional or employment-related information, including:
- Recruitment, employment, or engagement information such as application forms and information included in a resume, cover letter, or otherwise provided through any application or engagement process; and copies of identification documents, such as driver’s licenses, passports, and visas; and background screening results and references.
- Career information such as job titles; work history; work dates and work locations; information about skills, qualifications, experience, publications, speaking engagements, and preferences; and professional memberships
- Education Information such as institutions attended, degrees, certifications, training courses, publications, and transcript information.
- Legally protected classification information such as race, sex/gender, religious/ philosophical beliefs, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service, nationality, ethnicity, request for family care leave, political opinions, and criminal history.
- Other information such as any information you voluntarily choose to provide in connection with your job application.
- How We Use Personal Information

We collect, use, share, and store personal information from job applicants for our and our service providers’ business and operational purposes in the recruitment process such as: processing your application, tracking your application through the recruitment process, contacting references with your authorization, conducting background checks you authorize, and making hiring decisions. We will also use job applicant information for internal analysis purposes to understand the applicants who apply and to improve our recruitment process. We may sometimes need to use applicant information for legal purposes, such as in connection with any challenges made to our hiring decisions.

- With Whom We Share Personal Information

We will disclose job applicant personal information to the following types of entities or in the following circumstances (where applicable):

- Internally: to other Legion personnel involved in the recruiting and hiring process.
- Vendors: such as technology service providers, travel management providers, human resources suppliers, background check companies, and employment agencies or recruiters, where applicable.
- Legal Compliance: when required to do so by law, regulation, or court order or in response to a request for assistance by the police or other law enforcement agency.
- Litigation Purposes: to seek legal advice from our external lawyers or in connection with litigation with a third party.
- Business Transaction Purposes: in connection with the sale, purchase, or merger.
- How to Contact Us About this Policy – If you have any questions about this Policy, please contact privacy@legion.co.

title: Staff Engineer I, Software Engineering (f/m/d)
description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK 
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor’s list since its founding in 2009. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. 
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITHCoro is Bain’s persistent product development and engineering organization serving the firm’s digital solutions across Commercial Excellence (B2B) and the newly established Demand Generation Suite (B2C). Coro brings together technology, data, and services to build and operate proprietary solutions that create differentiated value for Bain’s clients and case teams.
This role sits within the newly established B2C pillar of Coro, building the technical foundation for Artemis – Bain’s AI-driven marketing and commercial investment allocation platform, and one of three products in the Demand Generation Suite.
WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM
The Staff Engineer I role is a full stack engineering position that builds end-to-end product features across the Artemis backend (Python/FastAPI) and frontend (React/TypeScript), ensuring the platform's user-facing capabilities are functional, reliable, and usable by consultants and clients in live engagements. Full Stack Engineers own specific feature areas within Artemis and the broader Demand Generation Suite product workstreams and are responsible for both the API layer and the React components that surface those capabilities to users. For Artemis, this includes the marketing mix model configuration interface, channel allocation dashboards, scenario planning tools, and client-ready output views.
This is a delivery-focused engineering role. The ability to ship complete, tested features independently — without waiting for a backend or frontend specialist to hand off — is the core contribution. Additional responsibilities include participating in support and operations by identifying system defects, leading troubleshooting efforts, directing code deployments, and mentoring junior engineers. 
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Feature Development- Own and implement complete features spanning backend API logic and React frontend components for Artemis product areas. Take features from specification through to tested, deployed code across both layers.
- Build and maintain backend routes for assigned product areas, ensuring request/response contracts are documented, versioned, and tested. Keep TypeScript type contracts on the frontend in sync with backend changes.
Frontend and Data Visualization - Build and maintain React components using the shared Demand Generation Suite design system, with a focus on marketing analytics interfaces: channel allocation dashboards, scenario comparison views, model configuration workflows, and executive-ready recommendation outputs.
- Write and maintain database queries, schema migrations, and data access logic for Artemis data models. Optimize for the data volumes and access patterns typical of marketing analytics engagements.
Quality and Collaboration- Maintain and extend the backend and frontend test suites. Ensure new features ship with adequate test coverage and do not degrade existing functionality.
- Participate in structured feedback sessions with Artemis Expert Consultants and go-to-market-aligned specialists to understand how tools are being used in live engagements, and translate that feedback into concrete improvements in subsequent sprints.
- Strong interpersonal skills, able to work across all levels of the organization.
- Support team in recruiting activities (resume screening, interviews, etc.).
Innovation & Emerging Technologies- Drive innovation through out-of-the-box thinking to solve critical business challenges and demands.
- Participate in technical discovery, POCs, and innovation workstreams to validate new tools, technologies, and designs.
- Investigate and keep up-to-date on emerging data, AI, and agentic technologies and trends; lead knowledge sharing.
- Entrepreneurial spirit, willing to try new approaches.

ABOUT YOU
Technical- Proficient in Python (FastAPI or equivalent async framework) for backend API development.
- Proficient in React and TypeScript in a production single-page application context, including state management patterns, data fetching, and TypeScript type safety.
- Strong CSS skills and experience working with component libraries and design systems.
- Strong hands-on experience and knowledge of relational databases: schema design, SQL, migration writing, and query debugging.
- Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g. Recharts, D3.js, or equivalent) for building chart-heavy analytics interfaces, including time series, waterfall charts, and allocation comparisons, is a strong advantage.
- Familiarity with AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) to speed up development.
- Experience leading and mentoring engineering teams in a fast-paced Agile environment.
- Results-driven, with an analytical, creative, and proactive mindset.
Education- Associate/Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
Experience- 5-8+ years of experience building full-stack web applications.
- Track record of delivering in an Agile environment.
- Strong troubleshooting and issue resolution skills.
- Strong communication and presentation skills, including documenting complex design and processes for long-term support & maintenance.
- Experience working with marketing, media, or advertising data, including familiarity with marketing mix modelling (MMM) inputs such as spend, channel, and campaign data, and how these are structured and used in analytics or measurement workflows, highly preferred.
- Experience building scenario planning or what-if interfaces where users adjust inputs and see modelled outputs update in real time is a strong advantage
