title: Senior, Software Engineer
description:
Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care. 

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our team and help build and support applications used across Teladoc Health.

This is a hands-on full-stack role. You will spend most of your time designing, building, testing, and supporting software, with a primary focus on Ruby on Rails and React. You will work closely with other engineers, product managers, and technical partners to solve problems and deliver reliable software to production.

We are also adopting AI-assisted development tools as part of our engineering workflow. We value engineers who know how to use tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or similar tools to speed up development, testing, debugging, and documentation while still applying good engineering judgment.

Healthcare experience is a plus. Experience with FHIR, HL7, Mirth Connect, EHR/EMR integrations, or other healthcare interoperability technologies is helpful, but it is not required.

What You'll Be Doing

- Build and maintain backend services and APIs using Ruby on Rails. 
- Build and maintain frontend applications using React, JavaScript, and/or TypeScript. 
- Design and develop REST APIs and integrations with other applications and services. 
- Work with databases and write SQL as part of day-to-day development and troubleshooting. 
- Work with Kafka or other messaging/event-driven systems where appropriate. 
- Participate in technical design discussions and help make decisions about application architecture. 
- Write unit and integration tests and help maintain a strong automated test suite. 
- Review code and provide practical feedback to other engineers. 
- Investigate and resolve production issues. 
- Participate in deployments, monitoring, and ongoing production support. 
- Work with product managers and other stakeholders to understand requirements and turn them into working software. 
- Document technical decisions, APIs, and important system behavior. 
- Help improve development practices, tooling, and engineering processes. 
- Participate in an on-call rotation as needed.

Required Qualifications

What You'll Bring 

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
- Strong hands-on experience with Ruby on Rails. 
- Experience building production applications with React. 
- Good understanding of Ruby, JavaScript, and/or TypeScript. 
- Experience building and consuming REST APIs. 
- Experience with SQL and relational databases. 
- Experience writing automated tests. 
- Experience with Git and modern software development practices. 
- Experience troubleshooting and supporting production applications. 
- Ability to take ownership of work from design through implementation and production. 
- Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with other engineers and cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in healthcare or healthcare technology. 
- Experience with FHIR, HL7v2, or CCDA/C-CDA. 
- Experience with Mirth Connect or another healthcare integration engine. 
- Experience with EHR/EMR systems (Athena/Cerner/Epic). 
- Experience with Kafka or other messaging platforms. 
- Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
- Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes. 
- Experience with healthcare data privacy and security, including HIPAA. 
- Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor. 

As part of our hiring process, we verify identity and credentials, conduct interviews (live or video), and screen for fraud or misrepresentation. Applicants who falsify information will be disqualified.

Why join Teladoc Health?

- Teladoc Health is transforming how better health happens. Learn how when you join us in pursuit of our impactful mission. 
- Chart your career path with meaningful opportunities that empower you to grow, lead, and make a difference.
- Join a multi-faceted community that celebrates each colleague’s unique perspective and is focused on continually improving, each and every day. 
- Contribute to an innovative culture where fresh ideas are valued as we increase access to care in new ways. 
- Enjoy an inclusive benefits program centered around you and your family, with tailored programs that address your unique needs.
- Explore candidate resources with tips and tricks from Teladoc Health recruiters and learn more about our company culture by exploring #TeamTeladocHealth on LinkedIn.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we never have and never will discriminate against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, religion, color, ethnicity, national origin, gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, membership in an employee organization, medical condition, family history, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, parental status, or pregnancy). In our innovative and inclusive workplace, we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind.

Teladoc Health respects your privacy and is committed to maintaining the confidentiality and security of your personal information. In furtherance of your employment relationship with Teladoc Health, we collect personal information responsibly and in accordance with applicable data privacy laws, including but not limited to, the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Personal information is defined as: Any information or set of information relating to you, including (a) all information that identifies you or could reasonably be used to identify you, and (b) all information that any applicable law treats as personal information. Teladoc Health’s Notice of Privacy Practices for U.S. Employees’ Personal information is available at this link.

title: Full Stack Engineer, Aladdin Data, Vice President
description:
About This Role

Full Stack Engineer, Aladdin Data, Vice President

Your team

You will join the Client Intelligence engineering organization within Aladdin Data, working at the intersection of data, artificial intelligence, and modern cloud technologies. The team builds scalable applications and platforms that enable intelligent client experiences and help drive commercial impact.

Your role and impact

This is a backend-focused full-stack engineering role with significant hands-on technical ownership. You will design and build scalable applications and platforms, with a strong focus on Java and/or Python alongside modern frontend development using React and TypeScript/JavaScript. You will own complex engineering initiatives from architecture and implementation through production operation, while helping raise engineering standards and mentoring engineers across the team.

Your responsibilities

Responsibilities

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:

- Design scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable architectures across backend services, APIs, data platforms, and user-facing applications, making informed trade-offs across performance, scalability, availability, maintainability, user experience, and cost.
- Remain hands-on in Java and/or Python, building distributed backend services, reusable APIs, components, and platform capabilities that support multiple products and use cases.
- Provide technical direction for modern web applications using React and TypeScript/JavaScript, owning capabilities across backend services, APIs, and frontend experiences.
- Build data- and artificial intelligence-enabled applications that integrate large language models, agents, enterprise data, APIs, retrieval systems, and efficient data access patterns into intuitive user experiences.
- Establish high engineering standards across code quality, automated testing, continuous integration and continuous delivery, security, observability, performance, and operational resilience.

title: Software Development Engineer, DSP Tech
description:
Description

Do you want to be part of the team that transforms how safety decisions are made for Amazon's Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across 21 countries? Are you passionate about building intelligent, data driven platforms that protect delivery associates every single day?

DSP SafetyTech is a newly formed team serving as the intelligence layer between safety signals and decisions — interpreting what happened, routing it to who can act, and ensuring no safety event goes unresolved. Today, safety data is fragmented across seven systems with no single technical owner, causing attribution errors, reconciliation gaps, and duplicated logic. We're changing that.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help build a governed safety intelligence platform. You will contribute to three critical pillars: Safety Data as a Service (SDaaS), a governed serving layer consolidating telematics, incidents, and contextual enrichment; DSP Facing Mechanisms, a unified configuration layer managing compound signals and business rules across DSP facing surfaces; and Advanced Analytics and Agentic Capabilities, predictive models and AI agents that provide actionable safety insights.

This is a rare opportunity to join a team building a platform from the ground up that will directly impact the safety of delivery associates worldwide.

Key job responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, and deploy software components for a governed data serving platform that consolidates telematics, incident reports, video evidence, and contextual enrichment from multiple upstream systems
- Build and maintain backend services and APIs that support a unified configuration layer where safety business rules are authored, validated, versioned, and distributed
- Develop frontend components for a consolidated safety dashboard, a single view where signals, scorecard outcomes, alerts, event video, and interventions come together
- Implement compound safety signals that combine individual data sources into higher order, actionable safety indicators
- Write clean, maintainable, and well tested code following software engineering best practices
- Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and operational excellence activities
- Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to integrate data pipelines and model outputs into production services
- Contribute to automated evidence preservation mechanisms to address short video retention windows
- Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, participating in on call rotations to ensure system reliability
- Work with cross functional teams including product managers, stakeholders across investigations, claims, insurance, and accountability to understand requirements and deliver solutions

A day in the life

You will be part of a team building the safety intelligence backbone for Amazon's DSP ecosystem. Your day may involve writing and reviewing code for backend services, building frontend features for the safety dashboard, discussing design approaches with your team, or debugging a production issue. You will collaborate closely with data engineers and data scientists to bring data driven capabilities to life. You'll participate in sprint planning, stand ups, and retrospectives, contributing ideas to improve both the product and the development process. You will have the opportunity to learn and grow across the full stack, from data pipelines to user facing experiences, while working on a platform that scales across multiple countries.

About The Team

DSP Safety Tech is a newly established team with a clear mission: convert every safety event into a clear, trusted action for every DSP, in every market, every time. Our North Star is ensuring every safety signal reaches the people who can act on it, with the context needed to make timely decisions, so risks are identified earlier, decisions are made consistently, and every Delivery Associate goes home safely.

We operate at the intersection of data engineering, applied science, and product development, serving stakeholders from investigators to insurance to DSP owners themselves. We're building from the ground up with a strong vision, executive sponsorship, and the freedom to innovate across the full stack, from governed data pipelines to AI powered agentic experiences.

We are seeking a passionate Software Development Engineer who can help us build the next generation of unified Travel & Expense systems and support the AT&E organization.

As a Software Development Engineer on the team, you will design and build services that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking experiences, automated expense workflows, centralized payment mechanisms, and real-time T&E analytics serving a global customer base. You will develop guided workflows, automated data integration pipelines, and conversational agents that significantly reduce expense report submission time and eliminate a meaningful share of expense reports entirely. You will build virtual payment capabilities and central card automation that reduce out-of-pocket employee spend and target zero manual reconciliation. You will develop AI/ML-powered fraud detection models that automate the majority of investigation checks and support transaction-based detection across expanding payment avenues. You will build a single-source T&E analytics platform providing real-time spend insights, policy violation tracking, and cost optimization visibility for managers and finance partners.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Member of Technical Staff based in India.

In this role, you will take ownership of technical features from initial concept through development, deployment, and ongoing production performance. You will build AI-powered agents and automated workflows that streamline complex healthcare operations and improve experiences for clinicians, patients, and internal teams. Working across the full technology stack, you will turn ambiguous challenges into practical, scalable solutions in close collaboration with clinical and operational stakeholders. You will join a flat, distributed engineering team where autonomy, product thinking, and end-to-end ownership are central to how work gets done. AI coding agents are part of the everyday development process, offering an opportunity to shape both the product and the engineering tools behind it.

Accountabilities

- Design and develop AI agents and automated workflows supporting healthcare operations, including insurance verification, prior authorizations, patient intake, claims processing, and clinical documentation. 
- Build and maintain web and mobile features for clinicians, patients, families, and internal operations teams. 
- Take ownership of ambiguous problems from initial discovery to implementation, collaborating with stakeholders to define requirements, write specifications, and deliver effective first versions. 
- Design and maintain backend services, data models, APIs, and infrastructure as code across the platform. 
- Manage services throughout their production lifecycle, including deployments, monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident response. 
- Develop evaluations for AI-powered features and monitor the performance and reliability of deployed workflows. 
- Handle protected health information responsibly, applying strict access controls, secure logging practices, and auditable changes. 
- Build and improve engineering tools, including AI agent skills, plugins, MCP integrations, and code-review automation. 

Requirements

- At least 5 years of professional experience building and shipping production software. 
- Recent, hands-on experience building or configuring AI harnesses, including project instructions, tools, MCP servers, skills, hooks, subagents, and evaluations. 
- A personal software project published online and accessible to users; experience building a SaaS product with working payment integration is a strong advantage. Applicants should share a link to their project. 
- Strong full-stack development skills, particularly in Python and TypeScript, with experience across frontend, backend, databases, and cloud infrastructure. 
- Proven ability to own products or features end to end, from problem definition to reliable production systems. 
- Experience working with large, established codebases and making sound technical decisions independently. 
- Practical experience building LLM-powered applications, including tool use, agent orchestration, structured outputs, retrieval, and evaluation frameworks. 
- Regular use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor, including configuring agent environments, managing parallel tasks, and carefully reviewing generated code. 
- Strong product judgment and the ability to make effective UI decisions using an existing component library. 
- High initiative, resourcefulness, and the ability to work independently while seeking context and input when needed. 
- Excellent written communication skills and comfort collaborating within a distributed team where specifications, pull requests, and tickets drive decisions. 
- Familiarity with healthcare or other regulated industries, including HIPAA, insurance and claims workflows, EHR integrations, or HL7/FHIR, is an advantage. 
- Additional assets include experience with Temporal or other durable workflow engines, React Native, production LLM evaluations and safety checks, custom agent harnesses or MCP integrations, and open-source projects or widely used internal tools. 

Benefits

- Opportunity to build impactful AI-powered technology that supports healthcare professionals and improves clinical operations. 
- End-to-end ownership and the autonomy to shape products from early concepts through production. 
- A flat engineering structure offering exposure to the entire platform and close collaboration with clinical and operational teams. 
- A modern technology environment combining cloud infrastructure, full-stack development, and advanced AI tools. 
- Daily opportunities to work with leading AI models and coding agents while developing new engineering workflows and integrations. 
- A distributed working environment that values written communication, initiative, and independent problem-solving. 
- Opportunity to contribute to a growing platform expanding across multiple healthcare specialties. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

 Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Role Summary

We are seeking a forward-looking AI Software Engineer to design, build, and scale next-generation applications leveraging cloud-native architectures, AI/ML capabilities, and modern engineering practices.

The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with expertise in distributed systems, AWS cloud technologies, platform engineering, and AI-powered application development. This individual will help establish foundational capabilities for AI agents, enable scalable agent orchestration frameworks, and drive adoption of AI-assisted software development practices across the engineering organization.

The role requires a passion for innovation and emerging AI technologies. The successful candidate will play a key role in building reusable agentic capabilities, integrating Large Language Models (LLMs), enabling AI-driven workflows, and delivering foundational services that accelerate the development of intelligent applications across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable cloud-based applications using AWS services.
- Build and integrate AI/ML-powered features and agents into applications using AWS AI services. 
- Leverage AWS Kiro and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software delivery, automate tasks, and improve code quality. Apply AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software delivery, automate repetitive tasks, and improve code quality.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.

- Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
- Stay up-to-date with the latest AWS technologies and industry trends.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

- 3+ years of experience in software development, with a focus on cloud technologies.
- Proficiency in AWS services such as EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, and CloudFormation.
- Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, Java, or Node.js.
- Experienced in deploying and managing applications using Red Hat OpenShift Service on AWS (ROSA), leveraging its robust platform for scalable and efficient cloud solutions.
- Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
- Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools.
- Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and tools like Jenkins, GitLab, or AWS CodePipeline.
- Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and building distributed systems.
- Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into applications (e.g., personalisation, NLP, recommendations). 
- Familiarity with AWS AI/ML services such as Amazon SageMaker, Bedrock, and AgentCore.
- Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Kiro) to accomplish tasks such as generating and reviewing code, writing and maintaining tests, creating documentation, and debugging, with the judgment to validate and own AI-generated output.
- Understanding of prompt engineering, AI workflows, or model integration patterns. 
- Experience working with generative AI or LLM-based solutions is highly desirable.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills.
- Execute with a Sense of Urgency
- Consistently prioritises safety and security of self, others, and personal data. 
- Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles. 

Behavioural Competencies

- Demonstrates strong ownership and accountability while fostering a collaborative, solution-oriented team culture. 
- Communicates with clarity and influence, builds trust, and engages effectively with diverse stakeholders across teams and geographies. 
- Continuously learns and adapts, embracing new ideas, emerging technologies, and innovative approaches to improve ways of working. 
- Shows curiosity about business needs and customer priorities, aligning behaviours and decisions to deliver meaningful outcomes.
- Collaborate with teams in EST timezone for one week each month, ensuring smooth coordination and support across geographies.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field. 
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Developer certification.
- Experience with microservices architecture and serverless computing.
- Understanding of networking and security principles in cloud environments
- Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) for connecting AI models to external tools and data sources.

About The Company

Delta Air Lines (NYSE: DAL) is the U.S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability and customer experience. Powered by our employees around the world, Delta has for a decade led the airline industry in operational excellence while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good.

In 2024, Delta was recognized by Fortune with a No. 11 placement on Fortune’s Top 50 Most Admired Companies list. Delta landed on TIME’s inaugural list of the “World’s Best Companies,” coming in at No. 12 – the only U.S. airline in the top 155. Delta’s people-first culture continues to be recognized, earning the airline a spot on Fortune’s 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for the fifth year. Delta is the only airline included on the 2024 list.

Additionally, Delta earned a coveted spot, on Fast Company’s list of the Most Innovative Companies, climbing from its No. 8 spot in 2023 to No. 2 in the travel category. The airline was recognized for its Wi-Fi revolution that is working to ensure the future of travel is connected.

About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore

Delta has fast emerged as a customer-focused, innovation-led, technology-enabled business. The Delta Technology Hub will contribute directly to these objectives. It will sustain our long-term aspirations of delivering niche, IP-intensive, high-value, and innovative solutions. It supports various teams and functions across Delta and is an integral part of our transformation agenda, working seamlessly with a distributed team to create memorable experiences for customers.

Why join?

- Technology is a key enabler of the differentiated services that Delta provides. At the DTH, you get the opportunity to work on projects with a significant impact on business outcomes and customer experience.
- Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs –exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships.
- Collaborate with research, innovation and IP co-development partners.
- Immerse yourself in an employee-centric culture.
- Develop deep and broad business acumen on airline operations while retaining focus on cutting-edge technology driven solutions.
- Avail a full range of benefits that support you and your family: Insurance, Commute, Meals, and Special Travel opportunities

We work across our Technology organization to ensure our platforms and services are ready for prime time by contributing to both the platform and software code bases.

What You’ll Do

- Influence the design and architecture of Wayfair system as part of Cloud Enablement journey; collaborate with development teams to design scalable and reliable systems, considering aspects such as fault tolerance, availability and performance
- Influence the design and architecture of Wayfair system as part of Cloud Enablement journey; collaborate with development teams to design scalable and reliable systems, considering aspects such as fault tolerance, availability, and performance

- Mentor new hires and other engineers by example, tech talks, paired programming, and other avenues to increase technical efficiency across the organization.

title: Application Developer-AWS Cloud FullStack
description:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Application Developer: AWS Cloud FullStack, you will work in a modern cloud-native environment, building solutions around microservices, API-driven architectures, and continuous release cycles. You will collaborate with teams to deliver scalable and resilient applications using Agile methodologies.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

- Develop Rich UI Applications: Design and implement rich user interface applications using Single Page Applications (SPA) or microfrontends, utilizing frameworks such as ReactJS or Angular.
- Build Scalable Backend Microservices: Develop scalable and resilient backend microservices based on 12-factor principles, exposing functionality via API and event interfaces, using programming languages such as Java, NodeJS, or Python.
- Implement Data Modeling: Design and implement data models using modern SQL and No-SQL modeling techniques, ensuring data consistency and integrity.
- Develop Event-Driven Applications: Build event-driven applications using Kafka, Zookeeper, and other hyperscaler cloud services, ensuring seamless communication between microservices.
- Manage AWS Services: Run and manage services on AWS, including PaaS, routing services, databases, event-driven services, observability, and DevSecOps tools, ensuring efficient and secure application deployment.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- Cloud-Native Development Experience: Exposure to developing applications in a modern cloud-native environment, utilizing microservices, API-driven architectures, and continuous release cycles via Agile methodologies.
- Programming Language Proficiency: Experience with one or more programming languages, including Java, NodeJS, Python, or .Net, and proficiency in frameworks such as Springboot, Quarkus, Django, or Express Js.
- Data Modeling Knowledge: Experience with modern SQL and No-SQL modeling techniques, including data model design and implementation.
- Hyperscaler Cloud Services: Exposure to hyperscaler cloud services, including Kafka, Zookeeper, and AWS services such as EKS, ECS, Fargate, Lambda, and API Gateway.
- DevSecOps Tools: Experience with DevSecOps tools, including CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CodePipeline, CodeCommit, and observability tools such as CloudWatch and X-Ray.

title: Software engineer
description:
Location: Noida, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Job Summary

As a Software Engineer – Java Full Stack, you will be expected to work as a self-driven, hands-on individual contributor with strong ownership of end-to-end design, development, validation, and delivery of product features across both backend and frontend layers. You should bring 3–6 years of experience in Java-based backend services, REST APIs, microservices, cloud-native deployments, and modern frontend development using frameworks such as React or Angular. While this is primarily an individual contributor role, mentoring remains an important expectation: you should support junior engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, implementation support, and knowledge sharing. The role also requires ensuring secure and high-quality delivery, supporting customer escalations, and driving innovation through PoCs and continuous improvements.

Job Requirement And Responsibilities

- The Software Engineer – Java Full Stack will be responsible for independently owning product feature development across backend and frontend layers, including design, implementation, validation, and delivery of scalable software applications and systems.
- The candidate should be hands-on, self-driven, and technically strong enough to contribute independently while continuing to mentor engineers, review code, and guide implementation decisions where required.
- The role requires strong individual ownership, proactive problem solving, and the ability to drive assigned work to closure with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively with product, QA, DevOps, and architecture stakeholders.
- Mandatory experience is required in both backend engineering using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, databases, and cloud-native patterns, as well as frontend engineering using React or Angular, TypeScript/JavaScript, UI integration, and responsive web application development.
- You need to follow development processes and security processes, and will ensure the technical quality of the solution with UTs coverage and handle/identify security vulnerabilities.
- You will work on Customers escalated issues.
- You will get exposure to working on cutting-edge technologies and innovation events.
- Drive innovation by proposing, prototyping, and evaluating new technical solutions (PoCs), and contribute to continuous improvements in performance, scalability, and developer productivity.
- Contribute innovative ideas for technical improvements and processes.
- Technologies should not be a constraint for the right person; however, strong hands-on exposure to Java full stack development is mandatory. The role involves Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, React or Angular, TypeScript/JavaScript, Kubernetes, and ownership of deployments and chart definitions for our applications.

Job Knowledge, Skill And Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics and Communication, or a related discipline, with 3–6 years of application development experience, including strong hands-on Java full stack development across backend and frontend technologies.
- Strong hands-on experience in designing and implementing REST API based backend applications using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot frameworks.
- Strong exposure to frontend technologies such as React or Angular is mandatory, with the ability to collaborate on UI architecture, review frontend implementation, and ensure seamless integration with backend services.
- Core knowledge in Data Structures, OOPS, Solid design principles, and common Design Patterns is must.
- Working exposure to any cloud stack (GCP, AWS) is must.
- Leveraging AI in routine work or personal POCs will be an added advantage.
- Exposure to Cloud and Kubernetes-based applications will be an important factor.
- The ideal candidate should be technology-agnostic, adaptable, and comfortable learning and working across different languages, frameworks, and platforms as required.
- Hands-on experience with a modern cloud-friendly programming language such as Python or Node.js. will be an added advantage.
- Experience in Unit Testing and any automation (BDD) framework will be nice to have.
- Good exposure to any relational database MSSQL or MySql.
- Exposure in Micro Services architecture and Docker based application will be an added advantage.

What do we offer?

At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

description:

We are looking for a skilled and motivated Full Stack Developer to join our development team. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of both front-end and back-end technologies and will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications.

About HID Global

HID Global powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places and things. We make it possible for people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely. Our trusted identity solutions give people secure and convenient access to physical and digital places and connect things that can be accurately identified, verified and tracked digitally. Millions of people around the world use HID products and services to navigate their everyday lives, and over 2 billion things are connected through HID. We work with governments, educational institutions, hospitals, financial institutions, industrial businesses, and some of the most innovative companies on the planet. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, HID Global has over 4500 employees worldwide and operates international offices that support more than 100 countries. HID Global® is an ASSA ABLOY Group brand. HID Global has is the trusted source for secure identity solutions for millions of customers and users around the world. In India, we have two Engineering Centre (Bangalore and Chennai). Global Engineering Team is based in Chennai and one of the Business Unit Engineering team is based in Bangalore. Check us out: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo

LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/hidglobal/mycompany/

Identification Technologies (IDT)

IDT is creating trusted identities for IoT applications through Smart Components and Enabling Services.

HID’s Identification Technologies powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places and things through smart components and cloud services. We make it possible for people and organizations to transact safely, work productively, and travel freely. Our contactless identification and sensing (RFID, NFC, and BLE) components and solution enabling technologies address the dynamic requirements across multiple industries to wirelessly connect, identify, collect and manage data quickly and accurately across virtually any IoT application.

Are You Ready to Join the Team?

Our company is committed to finding the best and the brightest talent to help us reach the top. If you are a dynamic, highly skilled, experienced Cloud engineer and technology enthusiast, and you enjoy working in a rapid pace within a rapidly growing business environment, then you will want to consider this position. If you excel at communication, collaboration, and unrelenting innovation, we want to talk to you. And if you bring dedication, positive energy and integrity to the table, you just might be the right fit for our team.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Roles & Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable web applications across the full software development lifecycle.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
- Develop and maintain APIs and backend services.
- Implement responsive UI components using modern JavaScript frameworks.
- Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
- Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability.
- Ensure application security and data protection best practices.
- Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback.
- Troubleshoot and debug applications.

Technical Requirements: (Good to have)

- Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
- Experience in Agile/Scrum development environments.
- Familiarity with Reactive programming
- Knowledge of authentication/authorization mechanisms (OAuth, JWT).
- Unit and integration testing experience using Jest, Mocha, or similar frameworks.
- Familiarity with secure coding practices and building enterprise-ready applications
- Familiarity with analytical databases such as clickhouse

Education and/or Experience:

- An undergraduate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is required, with a preferred graduate degree.
- Proven experience as a Full Stack Developer or similar role (5+ years)
- Solid experience with back-end development using Java (11 or newer), Spring boot
- Strong proficiency in front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript and modern frameworks like React.js / Angular (13 or newer) / Vue.js.
- Proficiency in working with Microservices, RESTful APIs and web services.
- Experience with databases – both relational (MySQL/PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis).
- Experience in writing unit tests using frameworks like Karma/Jasmine, Junit
- Familiarity with version control tools like Git.
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus.
- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Why apply? 

- Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
- Innovation: You embrace challenges and want to drive change. We are open to ideas, including flexible work arrangements, job sharing or part-time job seekers.
- Integrity: You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves, to feel appreciated and accepted.

This opportunity may be open to flexible working arrangements.

HID is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – Minority/Female/Disability/Veteran/Gender Identity/Sexual Orientation.

We make it easier for people to get where they want to go!

On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. HID technology is behind billions of interactions, in more than 100 countries. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.

When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

### Job Summary

Job Role - AI-Native Full Stack Developer

Experience: 8 years

Location: Hybrid (Hyderabad)

### About the role

We are changing how we build data governance and data quality tools. Instead of long requirements cycles, we work in very short loops: talk through a need, build it, show it, and improve it the next day.

You will work directly with a manager to build new features and functionality, with an AI coding agent such as Claude Code / Github CoPilot or Codex as the primary coder. You stay in control: you direct the agent, judge what it produces, and own what ships.

### What you will build

You will extend our self-service data quality product, which takes a business user from connecting a dataset to a data governance dashboard.

### What you will do

* Build and ship new features across the full stack, using an AI coding agent as your main way of writing code.
* Integrate the application with Collibra and Soda through their APIs.
* Meet with a manager every day and show working, incremental progress.
* Turn short conversations into working software, without waiting for formal requirements.
* Review, test and correct what the agent produces, so that it is reliable and secure.
* Deploy your own work and keep it running.
* Keep the agent productive with good instructions, context and project structure.

### What you need

* Mid-level full stack development experience, across front end, back end and databases.
* Real, day-to-day experience building with AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex or Github CoPilot.
* A full understanding of how to code and deploy using AI, from first prompt to running in production.
* Enough engineering judgment to spot when the agent is wrong, and to fix it.
* A track record of working quickly and showing progress in small increments.
* Hands-on experience integrating applications with third-party platforms through REST APIs, ideally Collibra and Soda.
* Strong Python with FastAPI or similar, and React.
* Clear communication, and comfort working directly with a technical lead with little process around you.

### Nice to have

* Experience with data quality, data governance or data-heavy applications.
* Working knowledge of SQL databases such as Snowflake, PostgreSQL, SQL Server and MySQL.
* Experience with Docker, Microsoft Entra ID sign-in (MSAL) and automated testing (pytest, Vitest).
* Experience building agentic or LLM-based features.

### Our stack

Python and FastAPI on the back end, with SQLAlchemy and pandas. React and Vite on the front end, with Microsoft Entra ID sign-in. Soda and Collibra integrations, Snowflake and other SQL sources, and Docker.

### How we will measure success

* Visible progress every day.
* New features turned around in days, not months.
* Working software in front of users, not long requirements documents.

### How to stand out

* Show us something you built with an AI coding agent, and tell us how you directed it, what it got wrong, and how you deployed it.

 Proficiency in Java Full Stack Development.

- Familiarity with database management systems such as MySQL or Oracle.

- The candidate should have minimum 7.5 years of experience in Java Full Stack Development.  
- This position is based at our Bengaluru office.  
- A 15 years full time education is required.  
  
**Qualification**  
15 years full time education

* 4 to 6 years of experience building production full-stack applications (React/TypeScript plus Python or Node.js)
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake, Snowpark, or Cortex AI
* Strong SQL skills and experience designing REST APIs
* Working knowledge of Git, Docker, and automated testing
* Experience with AI coding tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cortex Code
* Fast learner who is comfortable picking up new platforms quickly

  

Good to have:

* Exposure to Workday or other HR/payroll systems
* Finance-domain experience
* Familiarity with natural-language-to-SQL, RAG, or vector search
* AWS, Azure, or GCP experience; SnowPro certification

  

**Perks and benefits**

  

* Full-time role with a US-based Workday consulting firm
* Build cutting-edge AI data applications on Snowflake, with training provided
* Exposure to a large global payroll and finance transformation
* Hybrid work model
* Competitive salary
* Health insurance
* Other statutory benefits per the Government of India

  
  

**Based in Pune or willing to relocate; in-office 3 days a week. Immediate joiners or a notice period of 30 days or less preferred.**

title: Backend Technical Lead
description:
**ABOUT INVISIA SOFTWARE**

Invisia Software develops and operates digital products with an emphasis on dependable engineering, practical problem-solving and measurable product quality. Our teams build customer-facing applications and the services behind them, integrating external platforms and handling transaction-critical workflows.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We are looking for a hands-on Backend Technical Lead to take technical ownership of the backend services that support real-time availability, reservations, third-party integrations, payments and customer-facing APIs. You will design and write production code, guide backend engineers, strengthen reliability, and turn agreed product requirements into maintainable technical solutions. This is a technical leadership role, not a purely managerial or architecture-only position.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Backend design and hands-on engineering**

* Design, develop and evolve services, REST APIs, data models and asynchronous workflows using Node.js, TypeScript and AWS.
* Make sound technical decisions on DynamoDB access patterns, relational data, indexing, caching and queue-based processing; document important trade-offs.
* Build resilient integrations with external service providers, including timeout handling, retries, rate limits, idempotency and safe failure recovery.

**Transaction correctness and platform reliability**

* Own the technical integrity of reservation and payment workflows, including state transitions, duplicate prevention, callbacks/webhooks and recoverable failure scenarios.
* Implement controls and support operational reconciliation for transaction status, refunds and external-system mismatches; partner with the appropriate business and finance owners.
* Diagnose production issues using logs, metrics and traces; coordinate incident response, lead technical root-cause analysis and drive preventive fixes.
* Set and improve practical backend service objectives with engineering and DevOps, covering latency, errors, availability, capacity and cloud efficiency.

**Technical delivery and team leadership**

* Translate approved requirements into implementation designs, estimates, technical tasks and dependencies; raise risks early and deliver to agreed engineering commitments.
* Remain actively involved in development, complex debugging, design reviews and code reviews; unblock engineers without becoming a single point of failure.
* Mentor backend engineers, uphold clean code and secure engineering practices, and improve unit, integration and contract testing.
* Work closely with Product, TPM, Web/Mobile, QA and DevOps on API contracts, releases, incident prevention and end-to-end solution quality.
* Own backend-level technical decisions; align material architectural or platform changes with the designated Engineering Leader / CTO.

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND CAPABILITIES**

* Strong recent production experience with Node.js and TypeScript, including personally designing and delivering complex backend services.
* Usually 8-12 years in backend engineering, including demonstrated technical leadership of engineers or critical services; proven ability matters more than tenure.
* Practical AWS experience, especially with relevant services such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, RDS and CloudWatch.
* Good command of NoSQL and SQL data modeling, query optimization, consistency, caching and event-driven design.
* Experience with external APIs and transaction-critical workflows; understands idempotency, observability, failure modes and data integrity.
* Evidence of production troubleshooting, code quality improvements, automated testing and safe deployments.
* Clear technical communication, ownership of outcomes and the ability to make pragmatic decisions in a growing engineering team.

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* Experience with reservation, availability, inventory, e-commerce, marketplace or payment processing systems.
* Stripe, Redis, Datadog, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD automation or comparable tooling.
* Experience improving a live platform incrementally while preserving service continuity.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* Within the first 90 days, develop a working understanding of critical backend services, map key failure and performance risks, and deliver prioritized improvements with the team.
* Establish meaningful service baselines, visible engineering-quality practices and clear technical ownership for important backend components.
* Over time, demonstrate measurable gains in transaction reliability, incident recurrence, API performance, code quality and predictable technical delivery.

**SELECTION PROCESS**

Introductory discussion and experience review; practical backend system-design / debugging exercise; deep technical discussion and code review; leadership and collaboration interview. We focus on evidence of work personally owned and problems solved.

About Us

When Petpoojas first avatar came into being in 2011, it was a simple B2B food delivery model that took bulk food orders from the corporates passed them forward to the restaurants. But soon, our founders realised that the restaurants they worked with were not living up to their potential and were shutting down forever. Primarily it was due to a lack of coherent technology that could support their daily operations. Their billing machines were as bulky, tedious and old as time. Due to this, the restaurants never had an actual estimate of their profit margins expenses. Back then, restaurants were suffering more than growing.  
  
This was when our founders decided to build a robust, user-friendly cost-effective billing software for SMB restaurants that will automate everyday operations and push businesses towards sustainability.

title: Technical Lead, Delivery and Pre-Sales
description:
**You will turn client conversations into software that ships on estimate**

MTechZilla is a custom software development company with a team of 30+ in Pune. We build web, mobile, cloud and AI products for startups and businesses, primarily in the US and Europe, and have delivered 40+ products.

You will be the technical person in the room with our clients. You join discovery calls, design the solution, write the estimate behind our quotation, turn requirements into stories developers can build from, and stay with the project until release.

You will run 5 to 6 client projects at a time, each with a team of 3 to 6 developers per project. Expect about 20% of your week on architecture and code review, and 80% on client work, requirements, estimates, and delivery.

**Who this role fits**

This role fits you if:

* You are a senior developer or tech lead at a software agency or startup.
* You already estimate work and talk to clients directly.
* You want to own a project from the first call to release, and not only the code.

It does not fit you if:

* You want to write code for most of the week.
* You manage through team leads or a project management office.
* You have not reviewed code or written an estimate yourself in the last two years.

**What you will be responsible for**

**Design solutions and write estimates for new leads**

Every quotation we send depends on this part of the role.

* Join discovery and pre-sales calls as the technical lead.
* Answer a lead's technical questions on calls and in writing, so the growth team does not have to wait for a developer.
* Design the solution: architecture, tech stack, integrations and hosting approach.
* Break requirements into features and tasks, and estimate effort and timelines.
* Complete the technical sections of our quotation: scope, assumptions, exclusions, team composition, milestones and timeline.
* Estimate AWS and third-party costs where relevant.
* Split a product into phases that fit the client's budget.
* Review SOWs for technical and delivery feasibility before they are signed.

**Turn client briefs into stories developers can build from**

* Run discovery and requirements sessions with clients.
* Write user stories and acceptance criteria that developers can build from without guesswork.
* Prioritize features by business value, effort and risk.
* Answer your clients' technical questions during the project: architecture, feasibility, timelines and costs.
* When you do not have the answer, find it and reply within one working day.

**Keep projects on scope, on time and on budget**

* Own delivery of your projects from kickoff to release and handover.
* Compare time spent against the estimate every week, and raise overruns early.
* Turn scope changes into approved, billable change orders.
* Track risks and blockers every week, and act on them before they reach the client.
* Run sprint demos and status reviews, and tell clients about risks before dates are missed.
* Coordinate with QA so every release is tested before a client sees it.
* Send a one-page weekly report to leadership for each project: status, budget, top risk and decisions needed.
* Spot follow-on work in existing projects, propose it to the client, and bring it to the growth team to close.

**Lead the developers on your projects**

* Set priorities for your project teams. Changes to who works on your projects go through you.
* Review architecture and code on critical projects.
* Run stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, and follow through on action items.
* Run projects in Jira and keep requirements, architecture decisions, and handover notes in Confluence.

**What you will grow into**

After your first six months, you will take on more of how we work:

* A reusable estimation model built from past projects, so quotes get faster and more accurate.
* Our standards for documentation, sprints, QA gates, and releases.
* Hiring and interviews for the engineering team.

**Technical skills you need**

You need to design a system, judge whether a developer's estimate is realistic, and hold a technical conversation with a client's CTO.

* At least 3 years as a hands-on software engineer.
* Working knowledge of our stack, deep enough to design and review solutions: React and Next.js, React Native, Node.js and AWS.
* System design: APIs, databases, authentication, scaling, and third-party integrations such as payments, maps and notifications.

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a GenAI Engineer to create, build, and scale production-grade Generative AI solutions that drive measurable business impact across enterprise operations. In this role, you will translate complex business challenges into intelligent, LLM-powered applications — including copilots, conversational agents, document intelligence platforms, and AI-driven automation deeply integrated with core enterprise systems.

  

You will work hands-on with leading managed and open-source LLM platforms — including Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, and open-source models — alongside enterprise-grade create frameworks such as Microsoft Copilot Studio. A critical dimension of this role is integrating GenAI capabilities into SAP S/4HANA and adjacent enterprise applications using APIs, events, OData services, and process orchestration.

  

This is a high-impact engineering role sitting at the intersection of AI innovation and enterprise technology. You will collaborate closely with product managers, SAP functional teams, backend engineers, and cloud platform architects to deliver AI capabilities that are not just technically sound but secure, compliant, cost-efficient, and ready for enterprise-scale adoption.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

** GenAI Platform Engineering:**   

* Create, develop, and deploy GenAI solutions using Azure OpenAI Service and AWS Bedrock, selecting appropriate foundation models (GPT-4o, Claude, Titan, Llama, Mistral) based on use-case requirements.
* Build, configure, and publish enterprise copilots using Microsoft Copilot Studio or equivalent low-code/pro-code frameworks, integrating with M365, Teams, SharePoint, and Dataverse.
* Architect and implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines using vector databases (Azure AI Search, OpenSearch, Pinecone) and structured knowledge bases.
* Develop prompt engineering strategies — including few-shot prompting, chain-of-thought, and system instruction create — to optimize LLM output quality and consistency.

  

** Enterprise System Integration:**   

* Integrate GenAI capabilities with SAP S/4HANA using OData APIs, SAP Business Accelerator Hub connectors, event-driven architectures (SAP Event Mesh, BTP), and process triggers
* Build and maintain secure API layers (REST, GraphQL) tyingcting AI services to ERP, CRM, and operational data sources
* Collaborate with SAP functional and Basis teams to align AI touchpoints with existing business processes, authorization models, and data governance policies

** Architecture & Collaboration:**   

* Contribute to GenAI architecture decisions including platform selection, cost optimization strategies, multi-region deployment, and security design.
* Mentor associate engineers and participate in internal knowledge sharing through design reviews, documentation, and community of practice sessions.
* Engage with product managers and business stakeholders to translate functional requirements into technically feasible AI solution designs.

** Evaluation, Monitoring & Capable AI:**   

* Design and implement LLM evaluation frameworks covering accuracy, hallucination rates, latency, cost per token, and end-user satisfaction metrics.
* Establish monitoring pipelines for production AI applications using tools such as Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, and LangSmith.
* Apply capableble AI practices including content filtering, guardrails (Azure Content Safety, Bedrock Guardrails), bias detection, and explainability mechanisms.
* Manage model versioning, deprecation cycles, and prompt version control to ensure production stability

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years focused on Generative AI, LLMs, or applied ML in production environments.
* Hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI Service and AWS Bedrock — including model deployment, API integration, token management, and cost governance.
* Practical experience building copilots or AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Studio, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent agentic frameworks.
* Strong understanding of RAG architecture, vector embeddings, chunking strategies, and retrieval optimization.
* Proficiency in Python (primary) and at least one secondary language (TypeScript, Java, or Node.js).
* Experience integrating AI services with enterprise systems — ideally SAP S/4HANA — using OData, REST APIs, or event-driven patterns.
* Solid understanding of enterprise security requirements including OAuth 2.0, managed identities, RBAC, secret management, and data residency compliance.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms: Microsoft Azure (preferred), AWS, or GCP for deploying and scaling AI workloads.
* Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines for AI application deployments.
* Experience with SAP Joule and SAP AI Core.
* Knowledge of SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) services, SAP Integration Suite, or SAP AI Core

**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

**Our Package**
---------------

BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.

BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.

Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.

We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

Rocketlane is building world-class software for customer onboarding, professional services, and modern service delivery teams.

We care deeply about product craft. Our engineers work closely with Product and Design to solve complex problems, build delightful user experiences, and create systems that remain fast and reliable as we scale.

If you enjoy owning a problem end-to-end — from the database and APIs all the way to the interactions a customer sees in the browser — this role is for you.

---------------------

As a **Lead Full Stack Engineer**, you will own meaningful parts of the Rocketlane product from design through production.

You will:

* Design and build features end-to-end across our **React frontend and Java backend**.
* Work closely with Product and Design to turn customer problems into simple, thoughtful product experiences.

* Design clean APIs, data models, and backend services that can scale as our customers and usage grow.
* Solve challenging product problems involving real-time collaboration, rich interactive experiences, workflow automation, large datasets, and highly configurable enterprise use cases.
* Make thoughtful architectural decisions across frontend, backend, database, caching, and asynchronous processing.
* Own the performance and reliability of what you build — from browser performance through API latency and database queries.
* Debug complex issues across the entire stack rather than stopping at service boundaries.
* Write maintainable, well-tested code and raise the quality bar through thoughtful code reviews.
* Identify technical debt and proactively improve architecture, developer experience, observability, and engineering productivity.
* Mentor engineers and help the team make better technical decisions.
* Take ownership of features in production and work with the team to diagnose and resolve issues quickly.
* Participate actively in engineering design discussions and influence how Rocketlane's technology evolves.

**You should apply if**
-----------------------

### **Frontend**

You are comfortable with:

* React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript
* SPA architecture and component design
* HTML and CSS
* State management and complex client-side application flows
* Browser fundamentals such as caching, storage, networking, and rendering
* Building reusable components and maintainable frontend architecture
* Frontend performance profiling and optimization
* Building responsive and high-quality product experiences

Experience with real-time applications, WebSockets, large data-heavy interfaces, rich editors, or spreadsheet-like experiences is a plus.

### **Backend**

You have strong fundamentals in:

* Java and Spring or similar backend frameworks
* HTTP and REST API design
* PostgreSQL or other relational databases
* Data modelling and query performance
* Redis and caching
* Asynchronous processing and message brokers
* Designing scalable and resilient backend services
* Performance optimization
* Debugging and root-cause analysis
* Logging, monitoring, and production troubleshooting

### **Engineering fundamentals**

Beyond knowing frameworks, we expect you to understand **why systems behave the way they do**.

You should be comfortable discussing topics such as:

* API and system design
* Database transactions and concurrency
* Caching strategies
* Distributed systems fundamentals
* Failure handling and resiliency
* Performance and scalability
* Security and authorization
* Testing strategy
* Production observability
* Clean code and maintainable architecture

**What we're really looking for**
---------------------------------

We're **not looking for someone who is 50% frontend and 50% backend but shallow in both**.

We're looking for an engineer who has strong depth in at least one part of the stack, solid engineering fundamentals across the other, and the ability to independently take a customer problem from:

**Problem Design Architecture Backend Frontend Production**

You should be someone who asks:

“What is the right solution for the customer and the product?”

rather than:

“Is this a frontend problem or a backend problem?”

**You'll thrive here if**
-------------------------

* You enjoy owning problems rather than just completing tickets.
* You care about both **how a product works and how it feels to use**.
* You can move quickly without compromising engineering fundamentals.
* You are comfortable working through ambiguity and breaking large problems into smaller ones.
* You enjoy collaborating directly with Product and Design.
* You are willing to dive into unfamiliar parts of the stack when the problem requires it.
* You care about performance, reliability, and maintainability — not just getting something to work.
* You enjoy mentoring other engineers while remaining deeply hands-on.
* You like learning, experimenting, and continuously improving the way software is built.

----------------

* Docker/containerization experience
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines

**Why Rocketlane?**
-------------------

### **Build challenging product experiences**

You'll work on problems that go well beyond basic CRUD applications — collaborative workflows, highly interactive interfaces, automation, data-heavy experiences, enterprise integrations, and increasingly AI-powered experiences.

### **Own meaningful parts of the product**

Engineers at Rocketlane are expected to understand the problem, contribute to the solution, build it, ship it, and learn from how customers use it.

### **Work across boundaries**

You won't be constrained by artificial frontend/backend boundaries. If solving the problem requires changing the UI, API, data model, cache, or infrastructure, you'll have the opportunity to work across all of them.

### **Raise your engineering bar**

You'll work alongside engineers, designers, and product leaders who care deeply about building a world-class SaaS product.

And most importantly, you'll have the opportunity to look at something customers use every day and say:

**“I built that.”**

We're a small engineering team, so scope is wide and ownership is real. You'll ship to production in your first week, and every week after that.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Overview
Join the Microsoft Foundry engineering team building core experiences and platform capabilities that enable developers and enterprises to build, customize, deploy, and operate AI applications and agents.The team owns end-to-end engineering across customer-facing experiences, backend services, platform infrastructure, and AI enablement workflows. Our work includes agent-building experiences, model onboarding and catalog experiences, fine-tuning and training workflows, compute scenarios, and the services that allow customers to build and operate AI solutions at scale.
Engineers work across the full software lifecycle: architecture, technical design, implementation, testing, reliability, operational excellence, and long-term platform evolution. We value strong technical fundamentals, customer obsession, engineering excellence, collaboration, growth mindset, adaptability, and inclusive teamwork.

Responsibilities
Responsibilities  

- Lead technical design and solutioning for complex initiatives across Microsoft Foundry experiences and platform capabilities.
- Drive architecture, engineering principles, scalability, reliability, security, and long-term platform health.
- Provide technical leadership across full-stack systems, including customer experiences, backend services, platform components, and infrastructure dependencies.
- Influence engineering direction across multiple projects and partner teams.
- Guide design reviews, technical tradeoffs, and implementation strategies.
- Shape responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices and modern engineering standards.
- Mentor senior engineers and act as a trusted technical leader across the organization.

Qualifications
Required/Minimum Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field and 10+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent experience.
- Experience leading architecture and technical design for large-scale distributed systems.
- Experience with full-stack engineering, platform development, or large production services.
- Practical experience with AI/ML technologies, generative AI, agents, or related solutions.
- Experience driving technical alignment across multiple stakeholders and teams.

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience building AI platforms, developer platforms, or enterprise-scale cloud services.
- Experience with Microsoft Foundry, Azure services, model lifecycle management, agent frameworks, or machine learning systems.
- Experience improving engineering systems, standards, and architectural practices across organizations.
- Experience mentoring senior engineers and leading complex cross-team initiatives.
